topic: Pourquoi tes doigts se rident dans l'eau

through_line.name: le sillon sur la pulpe du doigt
through_line.progression: constate en bloc un (les plis apparaissent sur les doigts sortis de l'eau, sans cause visible) -> explique en bloc deux (le nerf commande, les vaisseaux se raccourcissent et tirent la surface vers le bas, qui se plisse) -> prouve en bloc trois (le doigt au nerf coupe reste lisse, et les sillons evacuent l'eau comme des rainures de pneu) -> utilise en bloc quatre (les sillons permettent de tenir un verre mouille sans glisser)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final montre les sillons en train de servir : le personnage tient fermement un verre mouille. Le pli du hook n'etait pas un accident subi mais un outil fabrique a la demande par le systeme nerveux

blocks.vo_line: Après un long bain, tes doigts se couvrent de petits plis. On croit généralement que la peau absorbe l'eau et gonfle, mais c'est entièrement faux.
blocks.through_line_state: constate : les sillons apparaissent sur la pulpe, on les voit sans comprendre d'ou ils viennent
shots: WIDE static: the person kneels on the floor beside the lavender tub, sleeves pushed up, swirling one hand slowly in the blue water
MEDIUM static: they keep swirling, resting their chin on the other hand, looking bored and patient while foam blobs drift
CLOSE-UP static: they lift the hand clear of the water and hold it up, droplets falling back into the tub
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the pads of two fingertips, soft curved grooves creasing across their surface one after another
MEDIUM static: the groove badge swings in from the right and settles beside the person with a bounce, two sparkles popping

blocks.vo_line: C'est ton système nerveux qui commande. Il serre les vaisseaux sous la peau du doigt, et la surface, tirée par en dessous, se creuse en sillons.
blocks.through_line_state: explique : l'impulsion mint parcourt le nerf, les tubes lavande se raccourcissent et la surface se plisse juste au-dessus
shots: WIDE static: the cutaway at rest, the outer surface perfectly smooth, the three lavender tubes plump and round, the mint nerve thread dark and quiet
MEDIUM lateral gentle drift right: a bright mint pulse races along the nerve thread from the left and reaches the tubes
CLOSE-UP high angle static: the three lavender tubes squeeze thinner and shorter, pulling downward on the surface above them
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the smooth surface buckling downward exactly above one shortened tube, folding into a single soft groove, one baby blue sparkle popping at the fold
MEDIUM low angle static: pulled back, three grooves now cross the whole surface, each sitting directly above its shortened tube

blocks.vo_line: La preuve : un doigt dont le nerf est abîmé ne se ride plus jamais. Ces sillons agissent comme les rainures d'un pneu sous la pluie.
blocks.through_line_state: prouve : cote a cote, le doigt au nerf intact se plisse et evacue l'eau, celui au nerf coupe reste lisse et la retient
shots: WIDE static: two identical fingertip cutaways side by side; the left has a bright mint nerve thread, the right a pale greyed-out nerve thread with a gap in it
MEDIUM static: a mint pulse travels down the left nerve and its surface folds into three grooves, while the right one stays perfectly smooth
CLOSE-UP high angle static: pale blue water pours over the grooved left surface and runs away sideways along the channels, leaving it clear
CLOSE-UP high angle static: the same water pours over the smooth right surface and just sits there as one flat sheet, sliding about
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: one groove up close, a thin blue stream running neatly along its channel like rainwater in a tyre tread

blocks.vo_line: Ce sont donc des rainures utiles, pas un accident : elles aident à agripper les objets mouillés. Abonne-toi, demain on regarde pourquoi le soleil fait éternuer.
blocks.through_line_state: utilise : les sillons servent enfin — la main tient un verre mouille sans glisser, et le pli du hook devient un outil
shots: MEDIUM static: the person stands beside the tub holding a wet rounded mint drinking glass, gripping it firmly and confidently
EXTREME CLOSE-UP static on the badge: the three grooves on the pad deepen and a thin blue stream runs neatly out along each channel
CLOSE-UP static: their grooved fingertips pressed against the wet glass, holding without a single slip
MEDIUM high angle static: they look at their own hand and break into a pleased grin, giving it a small approving nod
CLOSE-UP low angle static: the person points at the viewer, a rounded sandy yellow bell shape pops in beside them and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
